subject: Forakora - flexible commit slabs & hosted-band proposal
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@forakora.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing — slab clarification and commit flexibility

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Forakora team is excited about Redwood's latency and the KV caching improvements. We're trying to align internal finance/procurement around an initial 12-month hosted commitment and had a few clarifying questions about the per-token slab structure in your standard rate card vs. what we'd need for predictable unit economics.

A few specifics:
- Our current estimate is 1.2B tokens/month to start, with projected growth to ~3B tokens/month by month 6.
- We need clarity on where the breakpoints are for per-token pricing and whether you support mid-contract tier re-alignments (e.g., moving to a higher commit without restarting the term).
- We're also evaluating a short initial ramp (3 months) at a lower committed level with true-up billing after month 3. Is that something Redwood supports?

If you can share a sheet showing the standard slab bands and an example of a custom commit proposal, that would help us get procurement comfortable. Can we get something by EOD Tuesday?

Appreciate it —
Sanjay
Head of ML Platform, Forakora

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@forakora.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@forakora.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — slab clarification and commit flexibility

Sanjay —

Great questions, thanks. Short answers up front:
- Slab breakpoints: standard hosted per-token bands are 0-500M, 500M-2B, 2B-10B.
- Mid-term re-alignment: supported; we call it a commit amendment (prorated).
- Short ramp + true-up: yes, we can structure a 3-month ramp with a true-up and a final settlement at month 3.

I'm attaching a draft commit sheet that maps your numbers to our standard bands and two custom scenarios: (A) conservative ramp then step-up at month 4, (B) larger upfront commit with tiered discounts. See attachment stub: Forakora_MAAP_commit_sheet.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB).

That said, your target effective per-token rates for the 3B/month scenario push into the custom-pricing band — I want to align internally on what flexibility we have on the rate card before I send a formal commercial offer. Looping in Karthik and Laura for quick internal approval coordination.

Next steps proposal:
1) Internal pricing approval (we'll confirm max discount and any minimum commit floor) — target 48 hours.
2) Share a single-line commercial term sheet + SOW draft for procurement.
3) Execute amendment for the ramp/true-up approach and schedule a post-ramp review.

If this timeline works, I'll follow up with the single-line terms and escalate for pricing sign-off.

Best,
Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-21T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Forakora pricing — discount window and approval path

Rishi / Laura —

Quick internal: For a 3B/month eventual run-rate we can consider tiered price bending, but primary constraints:
- Standard hosted rate card allows up to 18% across-the-board top-line discount at mid-market ACV levels. Anything >18% needs Pricing Committee review.
- We prefer commit amendments to be structured as sliding slabs (effective for billing) rather than aggressive one-off unit-rate concessions; that limits downstream mechanical complexity for accounting.
- Ramp + true-up is product-acceptable; legal will flag language around lookback settlement and overage caps.

Given Forakora's growth trajectory, propose we offer a two-phase commercial path:
Phase 1 (months 0–3): 1.2B committed, standard band rates, with true-up mechanism.
Phase 2 (months 4–12): either auto-escalate to a 2.5B commit at a blended discount (we'll propose X% — need to confirm exact number), or include an opt-in step-up clause.

Rishi: if the customer is asking for a single effective per-token target, send me the target; if it's within 18% we can sign off; otherwise I'll bring to pricing. Laura and Marcus, thoughts on operational risk (SLA/overage exposure) if we do a soft floor at 60% of committed tokens?

Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-21T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Forakora pricing — discount window and approval path

Karthik / Rishi —

Operational notes:
- We can accept a 60% soft floor (i.e., customer pays for 60% of committed tokens minimum, true-up settled monthly). Anything below that exposes us to utilization risk — recommend a modest overage surcharge for >30% variance under the floor.
- SLA: Forakora requires 99.9% uptime SLA in the SOW. That is within our dedicated tiers; for hosted we can offer 99.8% with penalty caps — need to call out in SOW if they push for 99.9%.
- Attach the SOW draft (stub: Forakora_SOW_draft_v3.pdf). Legal will want the ramp/true-up language explicit (lookback x3 months).

If the customer asks for an effective per-token number, we should present two options: (1) rate-card blended (no Pricing Committee), and (2) custom band with Pricing Committee approval (if they want lower than threshold). I'll prepare the single-line commercial and mark which option requires committee sign-off.

Laura
VP, Customer Success Ops

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@forakora.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@forakora.com>
Cc: procurement@forakora.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-23T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed two-path commercial and next steps (Forakora)

Sanjay / Emily —

Thanks for the details. Attached is a clean single-line commercial (snapshot) and the SOW draft for your review (stubs: Forakora_MAAP_commit_sheet.xlsx, Forakora_SOW_draft_v3.pdf). High level we can offer two paths:

Option A — Rate-card blended (no Pricing Committee):
- Phase 1: 1.2B/mo committed for months 0–3 at standard band pricing.
- Phase 2: Auto-escalate to 2.5B/mo at blended rate-card pricing effective month 4.
- True-up monthly; soft floor at 60% of committed; lookback settlement at month 3.

Option B — Custom pricing (requires Pricing Committee sign-off):
- Single effective per-token target for months 4–12 (you proposed $0.00009/token).
- If target is below internal threshold, we route to Pricing Committee; committee path adds ~48–72h for approval.
- Includes same operational protections (60% soft floor, overage surcharge details in SOW).

Ask: please confirm which option you prefer and whether procurement needs any additional docs for legal review. If you pick Option B and the price target is below our standard threshold, I'll escalate to Pricing Committee immediately.

Regards,
Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
